chunks: And by this chain, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Be merciful towards a mighty one who has been humbled, and a rich one who has become poor, and a scholar who is wasted in the era of the ignorant ones.
ai.seo_question: Who are the three people the Prophet instructed us to be merciful towards?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the transient nature of worldly power and wealth, urging believers to maintain humility and empathy during times of fluctuation. It specifically elevates the status of the 'alim' (scholar) who may be marginalized by a society dominated by ignorance, a key theme in Shia social ethics. This instruction serves as a reminder that true worth is not defined by current social standing but by enduring virtue and knowledge.

en.hubeali: H 14579 – And by this chain, who has narrated the following: Imamasws said that: ‘The Prophetsaww said: ‘
